title: WizardryPlayerManaTweaked
description: Bug fixes and updates for Wizardry Player Mana
body:
This is a fork of [Wizardry Player Mana](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wizardry-player-mana) by Zetta.

This mod is an addon for [ElectroBlob's Wizardry](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/electroblobs-wizardry), which replaces the mana system. Instead of mana being durability in wands, it is now an attribute attached to each player.



## Changes from the original:
- Bug fix: [PR#6](https://github.com/ZettaSword/WizardryPlayerMana/pull/6) the /addPlayerMana command would multiply current mana, instead of adding to it, when the provided value was a decimal value. Now decimal values work as expected.
- Texture update: I found the original mana bar unseemly. This version comes with an updated blue crystal texture instead, by default. If you want the original texture, use a resource pack.



## FAQ

Q: Will you update/port/backport the mod to any other version?

A: No, ElectroBlob's Wizardry itself is only for 1.12.




Q: Why fork it?

A: Since Zetta is no longer updating the mod, I have taken it upon myself to do so until he returns.
